component.name: ACMX2 Interface
component.summary: Real-time video shader and glitch processing interface

description.p: ACMX2 is a real-time OpenGL video processing engine with a Qt interface. This package includes the non-CUDA engine, live audio and MIDI support, and the MIDI-map companion utility.

ul.li: Fix Default-resolution window sizing for low-resolution video input under Flatpak.
Add OpenGL compute shaders, including mixed fragment and compute multipass chains and binary caching.
Add compute-shader authoring and shader-type display to the Qt interface.
Add a searchable built-in shader uniform reference and faster multipass replacement.
Filter duplicate secondary V4L2 camera nodes on Linux.
Retain the Intel IPP-optimized OpenCV 4.12.0 build and runtime SIMD dispatch.
Make shader-editor current-line and GLSL syntax colors adapt to light and dark interface themes.
Build OpenCV with Intel IPP 2022.1.0 and runtime SIMD dispatch for optimized x86_64 CPU processing.
Add a direct documentation link to the Flatpak release page.
Add sequential M3U/M3U8 audio playback with full-playlist repeat.
Add a Qt M3U playlist editor with ordering, sorting, shuffling, open, and save actions.
Show the current audible track filename in the playback HUD.
